text:
Rina Patel: dropped a quick prototype: compact p95 card with an inline density chip that opens a micro-modal for numeric entry. mock: https://redwood.design/mock/2168889999-compact-modal.png. Primary goals: prevent accidental handle drags, keep card height constant, and improve clarity on what the density does. PTAL.

Diego Morales: nice direction. one ask: if the chip triggers a modal, will that interrupt keyboard navigation flow? Also: prefer percent display (e.g., 75%) inside the chip rather than words.

Rina Patel: modal is keyboard-focusable and traps focus while open; Escape closes. chip itself is a button with aria-haspopup="dialog" and an aria-label: "Open sampling density dialog".

Priya Singh: accessibility nits: ensure button hit area >=44px, visible focus ring (3px) and use aria-role=slider inside the modal for assistive tech. Announce changes with aria-live="polite": "Sampling density set to 75 percent".

Oliver Grant: implementation concern: we currently query aggregation when density changes. Can we do client-only preview in the chart while modal is open, and only commit on Apply? prevents many intermediate server hits. For scrubbing we could use optimistic preview with a debounced commit on release.

Rina Patel: yep, plan is preview only until user hits Apply. For the quick scrub inside modal we show a transient visual and don't call server until Apply. If user types a number and Apply, we commit with a 500ms coalesce window to catch quick retries.

Diego Morales: chart behavior suggestion: when applying new density, freeze y-axis scale for 900ms and crossfade heatmap buckets so users don't get startled by sudden rescaling. Also animate the chip value change.

Priya Singh: copy suggestion for modal heading: "Sampling density (%)". Helper text: "Percent of requests used to compute latency aggregates. Higher values increase accuracy but cost more." Also low-density warning when <15%: "Low sampling may omit rare high-latency events."

Oliver Grant: backend will add a gateway coalescer for sampling commits. If >5 commits/sec from a session, gateway will return 429. We'll also emit metric gateway.sampling.commit.rate and a tooltip suggestion in UI: "Too many changes; try applying once."

Ava (design-bot): automated lint: chip contrast 3.3:1 (fail). suggested text color swap to meet >=4.5:1. ARIA checks: add aria-valuemin="1" aria-valuemax="100" when role="slider".

Rina Patel: action items: 1) Diego to mock micro-modal animation and chip state transitions; 2) Priya to finalize a11y copy + keyboard spec; 3) Oliver to wire gateway coalesce and metrics; 4) I'll update the prototype with adjusted contrast and upload hi-fi before Friday review.

Diego Morales: I'll also add a compact fallback: on very small widths show only icon + percent and open modal on tap.

Priya Singh: will add keyboard sequence: Enter/Space opens modal, Arrow keys adjust in modal (1% steps), Shift+Arrow 5%, Home/End min-max, Escape cancels. Announcements via aria-live on Apply.

Rina Patel: love it. leaving this open for the sync on Thursday. tagging @Oliver for infra readiness check. :sparkles:
